tagline: Give an agent the smallest useful storage scope.
introduction: A storage-governance companion for IronShard's public S3 and MCP context, helping plan permissions, traceability and recovery boundaries.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with IronShard? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Design a storage scope
capabilities.description: Translate an agent task into minimum object access requirements.

capabilities.title: Review an action record
capabilities.description: Explain what a supplied storage audit record does and does not prove.

capabilities.title: Plan a reversible workflow
capabilities.description: Describe review and recovery checkpoints for an agent's proposed storage work.

capabilities.title: Design IronShard challenge support
capabilities.description: Replay/state consistency tester. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Crash/restart produces same declared state or explicit conflict on supplied interface
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions
